rules.title: Service-account key creation and upload remain prohibited

assertions.message: The reviewed foundation must enforce iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation.
The reviewed foundation must enforce iam.disableServiceAccountKeyUpload.
Terraform must not create user-managed service-account keys.

rules.title: Cloud Run uses a dedicated runtime identity

assertions.message: The Cloud Run module must create a dedicated runtime service account.
The Cloud Run revision template must execute as the dedicated runtime service account.

rules.title: Repository Terraform contains no primitive roles or direct public principals

assertions.message: Terraform must not grant roles/owner, roles/editor, or roles/viewer directly.
Terraform must not directly grant IAM membership to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.

rules.title: Cloud SQL remains private by construction

assertions.message: Cloud SQL public IPv4 must remain disabled.
Cloud SQL must remain attached to a private network.

rules.title: Public traffic remains behind the reviewed HTTPS and Cloud Armor edge

assertions.message: The Cloud Run module must reject unrestricted public ingress.
The regional backend must remain attached to Cloud Armor.
The edge must retain deny-mode preconfigured WAF rules.
The edge must retain a request-throttling rule.
The HTTPS edge must require at least TLS 1.2.
The approved public edge must expose HTTPS on port 443.
HTTP traffic must redirect to HTTPS.
Managed DNS must resolve the application hostname to the reviewed edge address.
Load-balancer backend request logging must remain enabled.

rules.title: KMS keys retain rotation and destruction safeguards

assertions.message: Managed keys must retain an explicit rotation period.
Managed keys must retain an explicit scheduled-destruction delay.
Terraform must continue preventing accidental key destruction.

rules.title: Runtime secret payloads remain outside Terraform-managed state and images

assertions.message: The infrastructure must retain Secret Manager containers for runtime secrets.
Terraform must not manage google_secret_manager_secret_version payload resources.
Cloud Run must consume secrets through Secret Manager references.

rules.title: Cloud Storage public access protections remain enforced

assertions.message: Storage buckets must enforce public access prevention.
Storage buckets must use uniform bucket-level access.

rules.title: Projects retain required ownership, scope, and lifecycle metadata

assertions.message: Project creation must retain the full reviewed metadata label set.
Projects must continue to disable automatic default-network creation.
Production project deletion must remain explicitly prevented.

rules.title: Centralized organization logging plumbing remains present

assertions.message: The logging module must retain an organization-level sink.
The logging module must retain a centralized log bucket.
The organization sink writer identity must retain bucket-writer access.
The centralized log bucket must remain protected from accidental Terraform destruction.

rules.title: Repository country and environment scope guardrails remain enforced

assertions.message: Foundation project inputs must remain restricted to approved country tokens.
Foundation project inputs must remain restricted to approved environment tokens.
Workload inventory inputs must remain country-scoped.
